title: An Act to Change the Definition of "Machine Gun" in the Maine Criminal Code

summary.text: This bill redefines "machine gun" for provisions of the Maine Criminal Code governing offenses involving weapons. The new definition describes a weapon that shoots automatically more than one shot and includes parts of a machine gun or a combination of parts from which a machine gun could be assembled.
